title: Jameis Winston on Jaxson Dart-Abdul Carter issue: "We've grown from it"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jameis Winston on Jaxson Dart-Abdul Carter issue: "We've grown from it"
sources.description: On Friday, the Giants made both quarterback Jaxson Dart and linebacker Abdul Carter available to reporters to discuss the situation that unfolded when Dart introduced President Donald Trump at a rally and Carter reacted to the gesture on social media.
